updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.2.0 
- New F10 menu processing routine and error handling - mitigate large server F10 menu errors Foothold etc.
- Ignore larger F10 menus that exceed chunk limits, revert previous F10 handling changes.
- Remove all Pro licensing code and artwork F-14 Jockeys test AIRIO please.
- Major Update to add F-4E Phantom II Jester 2.0 - testers see Discord for how to setup your Voice Attack Profile.
- Fixes broken F10 message construction.
- remove WSO Cache messages from Voice Attack log and build seperate cache .json log.
- Move divert commands to WSO.vap so all variable cache based commands have multipart key phrases.
- Add ICS Hot Mic for F-4E in Hot Mic or Override uses the same proceadure as F-14.
- add support for WSO tuning radio to ATC and Pave Spike Readt and Standby commands.
- fix broken export for WSO revipients.
- Adds support for TACAN channels and stations for f-4E WSO.
- Add ICS Hot Mic for AH-64D Apache Works on Hot Mic or VOX.
- Fixes for CTD when payload empty F-4E WSO.
- Adds OpenKneeboard Out V1.0 Web Console.
- Fix Open Kneeboard Autobrowse bugs.
- Fix AH-64D Hot Mic not working with Hold AI Transmissions selected in MP tab.
- Support Jester 2.0 TACAN tuning of Assets, Tankers, Carriers, etc. 
- Add OpenKneeboard Out enhancments, METAR, TACAN, BRA, Tanker Type and formatting changes for Standard Kneeboard
